background: Citigroup is the holding company of the most international of the large US banks, with services, markets, banking, wealth and US personal banking as its main lines, and a multi-year restructuring behind it.
synthesis: Ratings are A- on average across all three main agencies, the weakest of them at BBB+, with one of the three on a positive outlook and two on a stable outlook; no agency has moved since a one-notch downgrade by one of them on 2 Dec 2015. Capital is on the weak side of US peers, CET1 of 11.8% and leverage of 5.2% both below their medians, while LCR of 117% is above the median. Leverage has fallen 0.4 points since 30 Sep 2025 with CET1 and LCR broadly flat (figures to 30 Jun 2026). Flagged items cluster on conduct, chiefly a UK fine for Russia sanctions breaches at a subsidiary in early September; the newest, on 23 Sep 2026, is a client event with no credit bearing.
